Script.name: Core
Script.script:
-- A reload owns a fresh runtime, but retains only validated profile settings. if dem and type(dem.shutdown) == 'function' then dem.shutdown() end dem = { separator = '&&', runtime = {timers = {}, handlers = {}, gmcpFields = {}}, settings = {areas = {}, hpLimit = 30, manaLimit = 10} } local owner = dem local active = true
function dem.trim(value) return type(value) == 'string' and (value:gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '')) or '' end
function dem.norm(value) return dem.trim(value):gsub('%s+', ' '):lower() end
function dem.validReference(value) if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil, 'Target must be one word.' end -- Only ordinary surrounding spaces are harmless; tabs/newlines are rejected. local ref = value:gsub('^ +', ''):gsub(' +$', '') if ref == '' or not ref:match('^[A-Za-z0-9_%-]+$') then return nil, 'Target must contain only letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.' end return ref end
function dem.message(value) local text = '[Demonic] ' .. tostring(value) .. '\n' if type(echo) == 'function' then echo(text) elseif type(cecho) == 'function' then cecho(text) end end
function dem.now() if type(getEpoch) == 'function' then return getEpoch() end return os.time() end
function dem.cancel(key) local timer = dem.runtime.timers[key] dem.runtime.timers[key] = nil if timer and type(killTimer) == 'function' then killTimer(timer.id) end end
function dem.defer(key, seconds, callback) dem.cancel(key) if not active or type(tempTimer) ~= 'function' then return nil end local timer = {} dem.runtime.timers[key] = timer timer.id = tempTimer(seconds, function() if not active or dem ~= owner or owner.runtime.timers[key] ~= timer then return end owner.runtime.timers[key] = nil callback() end) return timer.id end
function dem.bind(event, callback) if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler) ~= 'function' then return nil end local id = registerAnonymousEventHandler(event, function(...) if active and dem == owner then return callback(...) end end) dem.runtime.handlers[#dem.runtime.handlers + 1] = id return id end
function dem.schedule() if not active or dem.runtime.timers['hunt-step'] then return end dem.defer('hunt-step', 0, function() dem.step() end) end
function dem.step() dem.targeting.resolvePending() dem.defences.step() dem.hunt.step() end
function dem.joinCommands(commands) if type(commands) ~= 'table' or #commands == 0 then return nil, 'No commands supplied.' end for i = 1, #commands do if type(commands[i]) ~= 'string' or dem.trim(commands[i]) == '' or commands[i]:find('[%c]') then return nil, 'Commands must be nonempty single-line strings.' end end return table.concat(commands, dem.separator) end
local home = type(getMudletHomeDir) == 'function' and getMudletHomeDir() or '.' dem.settingsPath = home .. '/Demonic-settings.lua' local loaded = {} if type(table.load) == 'function' then pcall(table.load, dem.settingsPath, loaded) end for _, field in ipairs({'hpLimit', 'manaLimit'}) do local value = tonumber(loaded[field]) if value and value == value and value >= 0 and value <= 100 then dem.settings[field] = value end end if type(loaded.areas) == 'table' then for area, names in pairs(loaded.areas) do -- Room.Info area labels are opaque keys; preserve their spelling on reload. local key = type(area) == 'string' and area or '' if dem.trim(key) ~= '' and type(names) == 'table' then dem.settings.areas[key] = dem.settings.areas[key] or {} for name, allowed in pairs(names) do local normalized = dem.norm(name) if normalized ~= '' and allowed == true then dem.settings.areas[key][normalized] = true end end end end end
function dem.saveSettings() if type(table.save) ~= 'function' then dem.message('Settings could not be saved: table.save unavailable.'); return false end local ok, err = pcall(table.save, dem.settingsPath, dem.settings) if not ok then dem.message('Settings could not be saved: ' .. tostring(err)) end return ok end
function dem.shutdown() if not active then return end active = false if dem.defences then dem.defences.reset('Package stopped.') end if dem.ui and type(dem.ui.shutdown) == 'function' then pcall(dem.ui.shutdown) end if dem.hunt then if type(dem.hunt.stop) == 'function' then dem.hunt.stop('Package stopped.') else dem.hunt.enabled = false end end local keys = {} for key in pairs(dem.runtime.timers) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end for _, key in ipairs(keys) do dem.cancel(key) end for _, id in ipairs(dem.runtime.handlers) do if type(killAnonymousEventHandler) == 'function' then killAnonymousEventHandler(id) end end dem.runtime.handlers = {} end

Script.name: Targeting
Script.script:
dem.targeting = {kind = nil, source = nil} local targeting = dem.targeting local pending
local function change(ref, kind, source) source = source or 'manual' if kind ~= 'pending' then pending = nil end local previous = dem.target dem.target = ref targeting.kind, targeting.source = kind, source -- The scheduler sees selection changes immediately, even between prompts. if dem.hunt and type(dem.hunt.onTargetChanged) == 'function' then dem.hunt.onTargetChanged(previous, ref, kind, source) end if type(raiseEvent) == 'function' then raiseEvent('dem.targetChanged', previous, ref, kind, source) end return true end
local function select(ref, kind, source) local valid, err = dem.validReference(ref) if not valid then dem.message(err); return false, err end return change(valid, kind, source) end
function targeting.setPlayer(ref, source) return select(ref, 'player', source) end function targeting.setDenizen(ref, source) return select(ref, 'denizen', source) end function targeting.clear(source) return change(nil, nil, source) end function targeting.get() return dem.target end
function targeting.set(ref, source) local valid, err = dem.validReference(ref) if not valid then dem.message(err); return false, err end if valid:lower() == 'clear' then return targeting.clear(source) end if not dem.room.num or not dem.room.ready then local selection = {reference = valid, contextId = dem.room.contextId, source = source or 'manual'} pending = selection change(valid, 'pending', selection.source) -- Synchronous target consumers may replace or clear this selection. if pending == selection then dem.room.subscribe() dem.room.request('Waiting to identify the selected target') dem.schedule() end return true end if dem.room.identify(valid) then return targeting.setDenizen(valid, source) end return targeting.setPlayer(valid, source) end
function targeting.resolvePending() local selection = pending if not selection then return false end if selection.contextId ~= dem.room.contextId then -- Movement cancels the old exception without disabling automatic hunting. return targeting.clear('hunt') end if not dem.room.num or not dem.room.ready then return false end if dem.room.identify(selection.reference) then return targeting.setDenizen(selection.reference, selection.source) end return targeting.setPlayer(selection.reference, selection.source) end

Script.name: Balances and Vitals
Script.script:
dem.vitals = {hp = nil, maxhp = nil, mp = nil, maxmp = nil, stunned = nil, prone = nil} dem.balances = {bal = nil, eq = nil, action = nil, dead = false} local balances = dem.balances local resourceAuthority = {hp = false, mp = false} local readinessSerial = {bal = 0, eq = 0}
local function number(value) local result = tonumber(value) if result and result == result and result ~= math.huge and result ~= -math.huge then return result end end
local function boolean(value) if value == true or value == 1 or value == '1' then return true end if value == false or value == 0 or value == '0' then return false end end
local function release() balances.action = nil dem.cancel('attack-watchdog') dem.cancel('defence-watchdog') end
local function readiness(kind, ready, explicitRecovery) balances[kind] = ready if ready ~= nil then readinessSerial[kind] = readinessSerial[kind] + 1 end if balances.action and kind == (balances.action.resource or 'bal') then if ready == false then balances.action.lost = true elseif ready == true and (explicitRecovery or balances.action.lost) then balances.action.recovered = true if balances.action.kind ~= 'defence' or balances.action.confirmed then release() end end end end
local function stopIfDead(dead, hpUpdated) if dead == true or (dem.vitals.hp and dem.vitals.hp <= 0) then if not balances.dead then balances.dead = true if type(dem.onDeath) == 'function' then dem.onDeath() elseif dem.hunt then dem.hunt.stop('You are dead.') end elseif dem.hunt and type(dem.hunt.stop) == 'function' and dem.hunt.enabled then dem.hunt.stop('You are dead.') elseif dem.hunt then dem.hunt.enabled = false end elseif dead == false or (hpUpdated and dem.vitals.hp and dem.vitals.hp > 0) then balances.dead = false end end
function balances.onVitals(payload) if type(payload) ~= 'table' then return end for _, pair in ipairs({{'hp', 'maxhp'}, {'mp', 'maxmp'}}) do local current, maximum = pair[1], pair[2] if payload[current] ~= nil or payload[maximum] ~= nil then if not resourceAuthority[current] then -- The compact text prompt may use different units. Never combine its -- current value or maximum with a newly adopted GMCP resource pair. dem.vitals[current], dem.vitals[maximum] = nil, nil resourceAuthority[current] = true end for _, field in ipairs(pair) do if payload[field] ~= nil then dem.vitals[field] = number(payload[field]) dem.runtime.gmcpFields[field] = true end end end end for _, field in ipairs({'stunned', 'prone'}) do if payload[field] ~= nil then local value = boolean(payload[field]) dem.vitals[field] = value if value ~= nil then dem.runtime.gmcpFields[field] = true end end end for _, kind in ipairs({'bal', 'eq'}) do if payload[kind] ~= nil then local value = boolean(payload[kind]) readiness(kind, value) if value ~= nil then dem.runtime.gmcpFields[kind] = true end end end stopIfDead(boolean(payload.dead), payload.hp ~= nil) dem.schedule() end
function balances.taken(kind, seconds) if kind ~= 'bal' and kind ~= 'eq' then return false end readiness(kind, false) -- Duration is diagnostic only. A clock cannot confirm recovery. balances[kind .. 'Duration'] = number(seconds) dem.schedule() return true end
function balances.recovered(kind) if kind ~= 'bal' and kind ~= 'eq' then return false end readiness(kind, true, true) dem.schedule() return true end
function balances.beginAction(action) if type(action) ~= 'table' or balances.action then return false end action.resource = action.resource or 'bal' action.lost = balances[action.resource] == false action.readiness = {bal = readinessSerial.bal, eq = readinessSerial.eq} balances.action = action -- Local pessimism gates sends; it is not evidence of a server balance cycle. if action.resource ~= 'prompt' then balances[action.resource] = false end return true end
function balances.confirmDefence(action) if balances.action ~= action or action.kind ~= 'defence' then return false end if not action.confirmed then action.confirmed = true action.confirmedPrompt = dem.runtime.promptSerial or 0 end if action.resource ~= 'prompt' and action.recovered then release() end return true end
function balances.onPrompt() local action = balances.action if action and action.kind == 'defence' and action.resource == 'prompt' and action.confirmed and (dem.runtime.promptSerial or 0) > action.confirmedPrompt and readinessSerial.bal > action.readiness.bal and readinessSerial.eq > action.readiness.eq and balances.bal == true and balances.eq == true then release() end end
function balances.rejectAction(action) if not action or balances.action ~= action or action.lost then return false end -- A confirmed refusal has no balance cycle to wait for. Leave readiness -- exactly as observed; in particular do not undo beginAction's pessimism. action.rejected = true release() return true end
function balances.parsePrompt(text) if type(text) ~= 'string' then return end local fields = dem.runtime.gmcpFields local hpUpdated = false local function vitals(field, value) local resource = (field == 'hp' or field == 'maxhp') and 'hp' or 'mp' if value and not resourceAuthority[resource] and not fields[field] then dem.vitals[field] = number(value) if field == 'hp' then hpUpdated = true end end end local hp, mp = text:match('Health:%s*(%d+)%s+Mana:%s*(%d+)') vitals('hp', hp); vitals('mp', mp) local hp2, maxhp, mp2, maxmp = text:match('H:%s*(%d+)%s*/%s*(%d+)%s+M:%s*(%d+)%s*/%s*(%d+)') vitals('hp', hp2); vitals('maxhp', maxhp); vitals('mp', mp2); vitals('maxmp', maxmp) local eq, bal = text:match('%(([e%-])([b%-])%)') if eq and not fields.eq then readiness('eq', eq == 'e') end if bal and not fields.bal then readiness('bal', bal == 'b') end stopIfDead(nil, hpUpdated) dem.schedule() end
function balances.endPrompt() dem.runtime.gmcpFields = {} end
function balances.clearForDeath() release() balances.dead = true balances.bal, balances.eq = nil, nil balances.balDuration, balances.eqDuration = nil, nil dem.vitals.prone, dem.vitals.stunned = nil, nil end
function balances.reset() release() balances.dead = false resourceAuthority = {hp = false, mp = false} readinessSerial = {bal = 0, eq = 0} balances.bal, balances.eq = nil, nil balances.balDuration, balances.eqDuration = nil, nil dem.vitals = {hp = nil, maxhp = nil, mp = nil, maxmp = nil, stunned = nil, prone = nil} dem.runtime.gmcpFields = {} end

Script.name: Room Tracking
Script.script:
-- Room.Info owns identity. Item packets form an ordered, untagged stream: -- a room list can refresh the currently reported room, never establish one. -- Generations protect local callbacks and submitted target identities. dem.room = {items = {}, order = {}, retired = {}, ready = false, players = {}, playersReady = false, phase = 'unconfirmed', generation = 0, contextId = 0} local room = dem.room local lastReceivedRoom, refreshError local timerKeys = {'room-retry', 'room-fallback', 'room-timeout'}
local function id(value) if type(value) ~= 'string' and type(value) ~= 'number' then return nil end local s = tostring(value) if not s:match('^%d+$') then return nil end s = s:gsub('^0+', '') if s == '' then return nil end return s end
local function record(value, previous) if type(value) ~= 'table' then return nil end local key = id(value.id) if not key then return nil end local result = {} for k, v in pairs(previous or {}) do result[k] = v end for k, v in pairs(value) do result[k] = v end result.id = key return result, key end
local function changed(reason) if dem.schedule then dem.schedule() end if type(raiseEvent) == 'function' then raiseEvent('dem.roomChanged', reason or 'update') end end
-- Also used after Hunt retires an ID without waiting for another GMCP packet. function room.notify(reason) changed(reason) end
function room.living(item) if type(item) ~= 'table' or not id(item.id) or type(item.name) ~= 'string' or dem.trim(item.name) == '' then return false end local attr = type(item.attrib) == 'string' and item.attrib:lower() or '' return attr:find('m', 1, true) ~= nil and not attr:find('d', 1, true) end
function room.eligible(item) return room.living(item) and not item.attrib:lower():find('x', 1, true) end
local function nameWords(name) return name:lower():gmatch('[%w_%-]+') end
local function keyword(word) return word ~= 'a' and word ~= 'an' and word ~= 'the' end
function room.matchesReference(item, reference) if type(item) ~= 'table' or type(item.name) ~= 'string' then return false end local key, valid = id(item.id), dem.validReference(reference) if not key or not valid then return false end local ref = valid:lower() if ref == key then return true end for word in nameWords(item.name) do if keyword(word) and (ref == word or ref == word .. key) then return true end end return false end
function room.matchesAllowlist(item, allowed) if type(item) ~= 'table' or type(item.name) ~= 'string' or type(allowed) ~= 'table' then return false end local name = dem.norm(item.name) for entry, enabled in pairs(allowed) do if enabled == true and type(entry) == 'string' then local normalized = dem.norm(entry) if normalized ~= '' then if normalized == name then return true end if normalized:match('^[%w_%-]+$') and keyword(normalized) then for word in nameWords(item.name) do if word == normalized then return true end end end end end end return false end
function room.cancelRefresh() for _, key in ipairs(timerKeys) do dem.cancel(key) end room.refresh = nil if room.ready then room.phase = 'ready' end end
local function invalidate() room.cancelRefresh() room.generation = room.generation + 1 room.num, room.area, room.name = nil, nil, nil room.items, room.order, room.retired = {}, {}, {} room.players, room.playersReady = {}, false room.ready, room.phase = false, 'unconfirmed' refreshError = nil end
function room.reset(disconnected) invalidate() room.contextId = room.contextId + 1 lastReceivedRoom = nil room.subscribed, room.processingList = false, false room.disconnected = disconnected == true changed('reset') end
function room.subscribe() if room.subscribed then return end room.subscribed = true if type(sendGMCP) == 'function' then sendGMCP('Core.Supports.Add ["Char 1","Char.Items 1","Room 1"]') end end
local function hunting() return dem.hunt and dem.hunt.enabled == true end
function room.request(reason, blocking) -- A background query preserves a usable snapshot; it cannot invent one. blocking = blocking ~= false or not room.ready or not room.num local active = hunting() local previous = room.refresh if previous and previous.id == room.generation and previous.num == room.num and previous.active == active then -- A stronger request shares the original retry and timeout deadlines. if blocking then previous.blocking = true room.ready, room.phase = false, room.num and 'waiting' or 'unconfirmed' end return true end room.cancelRefresh() refreshError = nil if blocking then room.ready = false end room.phase = room.ready and 'refreshing' or (room.num and 'waiting' or 'unconfirmed') local refresh = {id = room.generation, num = room.num, started = dem.now(), attempts = 0, ihSent = false, reason = reason or 'Room refresh', active = active, blocking = blocking} room.refresh = refresh local function current() return room.refresh == refresh and room.generation == refresh.id and room.num == refresh.num and refresh.active and hunting() end local function query() refresh.attempts = refresh.attempts + 1 if type(sendGMCP) == 'function' then sendGMCP('Char.Items.Room ""') end end query() if active then dem.defer('room-fallback', 0.2, function() if not current() then return end refresh.ihSent = true if type(send) == 'function' then send('ih') end end) dem.defer('room-retry', 1, function() if current() then query() end end) dem.defer('room-timeout', 10, function() if not current() then return end local reason = room.num and 'The full room roster did not arrive.' or 'The room identity was not confirmed by Room.Info.' refreshError = reason room.cancelRefresh() if refresh.blocking then dem.hunt.stop(reason) else room.phase = 'ready' changed() end end) end return true end
function room.diagnostics() return {contextId = room.contextId, lastReceivedRoom = lastReceivedRoom, refreshError = refreshError} end
local function area(value) return type(value) == 'string' and dem.trim(value) ~= '' and value or nil end
function room.onInfo(payload) if type(payload) ~= 'table' then return end local number = id(payload.num) if not number then return end lastReceivedRoom = number local newIdentity = number ~= room.num if number ~= room.num then -- The first identity is a snapshot, so a pending initial selection keeps -- its context. Every actual transition starts a different target context. local transition = room.num ~= nil invalidate() if transition then room.contextId = room.contextId + 1 end room.num, room.area, room.phase = number, area(payload.area), 'waiting' if dem.hunt then dem.hunt.onRoomChanged() end local pendingTarget = dem.targeting and dem.targeting.kind == 'pending' if hunting() or pendingTarget then room.request('Room identity confirmed') end elseif payload.area ~= nil then room.area = area(payload.area) end if payload.name ~= nil then room.name = area(payload.name) end room.disconnected = false changed(newIdentity and 'identity' or 'update') end
local function player(value, shortName) if type(value) == 'string' and type(shortName) == 'string' then value = {name = shortName, fullname = value} end if type(value) ~= 'table' then return nil end local name = dem.validReference(value.name) if not name then return nil end return {name = name, fullname = type(value.fullname) == 'string' and value.fullname or name}, name:lower() end
function room.onPlayers(payload) if not room.num or type(payload) ~= 'table' then return end local players = {} for key, value in pairs(payload) do local entry, name = player(value, key) if entry then players[name] = entry end end room.players, room.playersReady = players, true changed('players') end
function room.onAddPlayer(payload) if not room.num then return end local entry, name = player(payload) if not entry then return end room.players[name] = entry changed('players') end
function room.onRemovePlayer(payload) if not room.num then return end local name = dem.validReference(type(payload) == 'table' and payload.name or payload) if not name then return end room.players[name:lower()] = nil changed('players') end
function room.onList(payload) if not room.num or type(payload) ~= 'table' or payload.location ~= 'room' or type(payload.items) ~= 'table' then return end local items, order = {}, {} for _, value in ipairs(payload.items) do local item, key = record(value) if item then if not items[key] then order[#order + 1] = key end items[key] = item end end local old = room.items room.cancelRefresh() refreshError = nil room.items, room.order, room.ready, room.phase = items, order, true, 'ready' for key, item in pairs(items) do if dem.hunt then dem.hunt.onObserved(key, item) end end room.processingList = true for key in pairs(old) do if not items[key] then room.retired[key] = true if dem.hunt then dem.hunt.onRemoved(key) end end end room.processingList = false changed() end
local function delta(payload, liveAdd) if not room.num or type(payload) ~= 'table' or payload.location ~= 'room' then return end local value = payload.item local key = type(value) == 'table' and id(value.id) or nil if not key then return end local item = record(value, room.items[key]) if not item then return end if not room.items[key] then room.order[#room.order + 1] = key end room.items[key] = item if liveAdd then room.retired[key] = nil end if dem.hunt then dem.hunt.onObserved(key, item) end changed() end
function room.onAdd(payload) delta(payload, true) end function room.onUpdate(payload) delta(payload, false) end
function room.onRemove(payload) if not room.num or type(payload) ~= 'table' or payload.location ~= 'room' then return end local value = payload.item local key = id(type(value) == 'table' and value.id or value) if not key then return end room.items[key], room.retired[key] = nil, true for i = #room.order, 1, -1 do if room.order[i] == key then table.remove(room.order, i) end end if dem.hunt then dem.hunt.onRemoved(key) end changed() end
-- This lookup may use a known same-room snapshot while its refresh is pending. -- It is for target ownership/removal only; resolve() below gates all attacks. function room.identify(reference, preferredKey, eligibleOnly) if not room.num then return nil, 'The room identity is not ready.' end local valid = dem.validReference(reference) if not valid then return nil, 'Invalid denizen reference.' end local ref, found, foundKey = valid:lower(), nil, nil -- A native identity must never redirect to another denizen's numeric name word. local exact = room.items[ref] if exact or room.retired[ref] then if room.retired[ref] or not room.living(exact) then return nil, 'That denizen is not in the current room.' end if eligibleOnly and not room.eligible(exact) then return nil, 'That denizen is protected and cannot be hunted.' end return exact, ref end local preferred, preferredItem, protected = id(preferredKey), nil, false for _, key in ipairs(room.order) do local item = room.items[key] if item and not room.retired[key] and room.living(item) and room.matchesReference(item, valid) then if eligibleOnly and not room.eligible(item) then protected = true else if not found then found, foundKey = item, key end if key == preferred then preferredItem = item end end end end if preferredItem then return preferredItem, preferred end if not found then if protected then return nil, 'That denizen is protected and cannot be hunted.' end return nil, 'That denizen is not in the current room.' end return found, foundKey end
function room.resolve(reference, preferredKey) if not room.ready then return nil, 'The room roster is not ready.' end return room.identify(reference, preferredKey, true) end

Script.name: Hunt Controller
Script.script:
dem.hunt = {enabled = false, reason = 'Disabled.'} local hunt = dem.hunt local selected, manualReference, stateWaiting, waitingGeneration, watchedAction local submittedByName, submittedById, submittedAny = {}, {}, false
function hunt.resetTerminalHistory() submittedByName, submittedById, submittedAny = {}, {}, false end
local function rememberName(action, name) if type(name) ~= 'string' or dem.norm(name) == '' then return false end name = dem.norm(name) local previous = submittedByName[name] local older = previous and previous.action local ambiguous = previous and (previous.ambiguous or (older ~= action and (older.retired or older.key ~= action.key or older.generation ~= action.generation))) or false submittedByName[name] = {action = action, ambiguous = ambiguous} action.names = action.names or {} action.names[name] = true return ambiguous end
function hunt.onObserved(key, item) local action = submittedById[dem.room.generation .. ':' .. key] if action and type(item) == 'table' then rememberName(action, item.name) end end
local function message(text) dem.message(text) end local function schedule() if dem.schedule then dem.schedule() end end local function cancelState() stateWaiting = false waitingGeneration = nil dem.cancel('state-watchdog') end local function waitForState(reason) hunt.reason = reason or 'Waiting for room or character data.' local generation = dem.room.generation if stateWaiting and waitingGeneration == generation then return end stateWaiting = true waitingGeneration = generation dem.defer('state-watchdog', 10, function() if hunt.enabled and stateWaiting and waitingGeneration == generation then if not dem.room.num then hunt.stop('Room identity was not confirmed after GMCP and ih recovery.') elseif not dem.room.ready then hunt.stop('A full room roster did not arrive after GMCP and ih recovery.') else hunt.stop('Required character data did not arrive.') end end end) end local function watchAction(action) if watchedAction == action then return end watchedAction = action local elapsed = math.max(0, dem.now() - (action.started or dem.now())) dem.defer('attack-watchdog', math.max(0, 10 - elapsed), function() if hunt.enabled and dem.balances.action == action then hunt.stop('The last action has not completed a confirmed balance cycle.') end end) end local function clearOwned() if dem.targeting.source == 'hunt' then dem.targeting.clear('hunt') end end
function hunt.stop(reason) local wasEnabled = hunt.enabled hunt.enabled = false if dem.room.cancelRefresh then dem.room.cancelRefresh() end hunt.reason = reason or 'Disabled by user.' cancelState() dem.cancel('attack-watchdog') watchedAction, selected, manualReference = nil, nil, nil clearOwned() if wasEnabled then message('Hunt mode off' .. (reason and ': ' .. reason or '.')) end if wasEnabled and dem.defences and dem.defences.enabled then schedule() end end
function hunt.onAttackRejected(reason) local action = dem.balances.action if action and (action == hunt.lastAction or action.kind == 'shield') and dem.balances.rejectAction(action) then if action == hunt.lastAction then hunt.lastAction = nil end end hunt.stop(reason or 'The submitted attack was refused.') end
function hunt.toggle() if hunt.enabled then hunt.stop(); return false end if dem.balances.dead then hunt.stop('You are dead.') message('Hunt mode remains off while you are dead.') return false end if dem.targeting.kind == 'player' then dem.targeting.clear('hunt') end manualReference = dem.targeting.kind == 'denizen' and dem.targeting.source == 'manual' and dem.target or nil selected, hunt.enabled = nil, true dem.room.subscribe() dem.room.request('Hunt mode enabled') waitForState('Waiting for a fresh room roster.') message('Hunt mode on.') schedule() return true end
function hunt.onRoomChanged() selected, manualReference = nil, nil if dem.targeting.kind == 'denizen' then dem.targeting.clear('hunt') end if hunt.enabled then waitForState('Waiting for the new room roster.') end end
function hunt.onTargetChanged(oldReference, reference, kind, source) if source == 'hunt' or not hunt.enabled then return end local preferredKey = selected and selected.room == dem.room.num and selected.key or nil selected = nil if not reference then hunt.stop('The shared target was cleared.'); return end if kind == 'player' then hunt.stop('A player target was selected.'); return end if kind == 'pending' then manualReference = nil waitForState('Waiting to identify the selected target.') schedule() return end manualReference = reference -- Retain known same-room ownership even during refresh, so a Remove packet -- can end this exception. step() still requires the fresh roster to attack. local item, key = dem.room.identify(reference, preferredKey, true) if item then selected = {reference = reference, key = key, room = dem.room.num, item = item, manual = true} if dem.room.ready and not dem.room.eligible(item) then hunt.stop('The selected denizen is dead or protected.'); return end elseif dem.room.ready then hunt.stop(key); return end schedule() end
local function finite(value) return type(value) == 'number' and value == value and value ~= math.huge and value ~= -math.huge end local function knownVitals() local v = dem.vitals return v and finite(v.hp) and finite(v.maxhp) and v.maxhp > 0 and v.hp >= 0 and finite(v.mp) and finite(v.maxmp) and v.maxmp > 0 and v.mp >= 0 end local function areaList() return dem.room.area and dem.settings.areas[dem.room.area] or nil end local function validateManualSelection() local room = dem.room if selected and selected.manual and selected.reference == manualReference and selected.room == room.num then local item = room.items[selected.key] if item and not room.retired[selected.key] and room.living(item) then if not room.eligible(item) then hunt.stop('The selected denizen is protected.'); return end -- A changed description does not make this a different physical target. selected.item = item return end -- The one-target exception ends here, rather than moving to another match -- for the same generic word. Automatic selection returns to the area list. local reference = manualReference selected, manualReference = nil, nil if dem.target == reference then dem.targeting.clear('hunt') end return end local item, key = room.resolve(manualReference) if not item then hunt.stop(key); return end selected = {reference = manualReference, key = key, room = room.num, item = item, manual = true} end local function choose() local room = dem.room -- step() has already validated this exact physical identity, not just its word. if manualReference then return selected end local allowed = areaList() if selected and selected.room == room.num then local item = room.items[selected.key] if item and not room.retired[selected.key] and room.eligible(item) and room.matchesAllowlist(item, allowed) then selected.item = item return selected end end selected = nil if allowed then for _, key in ipairs(room.order) do local item = room.items[key] if item and not room.retired[key] and room.eligible(item) and room.matchesAllowlist(item, allowed) then return {reference = key, key = key, room = room.num, item = item, manual = false} end end end clearOwned() return nil end
function hunt.step() if not hunt.enabled then return end local v, b, room = dem.vitals, dem.balances, dem.room if b.dead then hunt.stop('You are dead.'); return end local shielding = v and finite(v.hp) and finite(v.maxhp) and v.maxhp > 0 and v.hp > 0 and v.hp / v.maxhp * 100 <= 40 -- A known low percentage stops immediately, even while another field is missing. if not shielding and v and finite(v.hp) and finite(v.maxhp) and v.maxhp > 0 and v.hp / v.maxhp * 100 <= dem.settings.hpLimit then hunt.stop('Health reached the configured limit.'); return end if v and finite(v.mp) and finite(v.maxmp) and v.maxmp > 0 and v.mp / v.maxmp * 100 <= dem.settings.manaLimit then hunt.stop('Mana reached the configured limit.'); return end if shielding then if not knownVitals() or b.bal == nil or b.eq == nil or v.prone == nil or v.stunned == nil then waitForState('Waiting for character data to shield.'); return end cancelState() if b.action then hunt.reason = 'Shielding: waiting for the current action recovery.'; watchAction(b.action); return end watchedAction = nil if not b.bal or not b.eq or v.prone or v.stunned then hunt.reason = 'Shielding: waiting for balance, equilibrium, standing and unstunned status.'; return end local cost = dem.ritualism.manaCost({'inversion', 'hammer'}) if not cost or v.mp < cost then hunt.reason = 'Shielding: waiting for 18 mana.'; return end local command, err = dem.ritualism.buildTrace({'inversion', 'hammer'}, 'me') if not command then hunt.stop(err); return end local action = {kind = 'shield', started = dem.now()} if not b.beginAction(action) then return end hunt.reason = 'Shielding: waiting for confirmed balance recovery.' watchAction(action) send(command) return end if dem.targeting.kind == 'pending' then waitForState('Waiting to identify the selected target.'); return end if not knownVitals() or not room.ready or not room.num or b.bal == nil or b.eq == nil or v.prone == nil or v.stunned == nil then waitForState(); return end cancelState() if manualReference then validateManualSelection() if not hunt.enabled then return end end if b.action then hunt.reason = 'Waiting for the confirmed attack balance cycle.'; watchAction(b.action); return end watchedAction = nil if not b.bal or not b.eq then hunt.reason = 'Waiting for balance and equilibrium.'; return end if v.prone or v.stunned then hunt.reason = 'Waiting until standing and unstunned.'; return end local cost = dem.ritualism.manaCost({'fire', 'ice'}) if not cost or v.mp < cost then hunt.reason = 'Waiting for enough mana for the full attack.'; return end local candidate = choose() if not candidate then if hunt.enabled then hunt.reason = 'No eligible allowed denizens in this room.' end return end if not hunt.enabled then return end selected = candidate if not candidate.manual and dem.target ~= candidate.reference then dem.targeting.setDenizen(candidate.reference, 'hunt') end -- Target-change callbacks are synchronous; recheck before committing the send. if not hunt.enabled or dem.target ~= candidate.reference or b.action then return end -- The shared reference stays opaque; attack only the pinned room identity. -- Sending a generic word here would let the server switch matching denizens. local command, err = dem.ritualism.buildTrace({'fire', 'ice'}, candidate.key) if not command then hunt.stop(err or 'Cannot build the hunting attack.'); return end local action = {kind = 'attack', reference = dem.target, key = candidate.key, room = room.num, generation = room.generation, item = candidate.item, retired = false, started = dem.now()} if not b.beginAction(action) then return end local name = dem.norm(candidate.item.name) -- Text has no ID. Once another physical target could own the same name, -- defer that ambiguous text to GMCP rather than retiring its successor. action.ambiguousKill = rememberName(action, name) action.ambiguousMissing = submittedAny submittedAny = true submittedById[room.generation .. ':' .. action.key] = action hunt.lastAction = action hunt.reason = 'Waiting for the confirmed attack balance cycle.' watchAction(action) send(command) end
local function belongsToRoom(action) return action and action.room == dem.room.num and action.generation == dem.room.generation end
local function reconcile(action) if not hunt.enabled or not belongsToRoom(action) or action.refreshRequested then return end -- A proved retirement owns one reconciliation. Ambiguous text may describe -- an older target; a later real terminal event still needs a fresh query. if action.retired then action.refreshRequested = true end -- An authoritative full snapshot already reconciles its own missing items. if dem.room.processingList then return end dem.room.request('Submitted target left or died', false) schedule() end
local function retire(action) if not action then return end if not action.retired then action.retired = true if belongsToRoom(action) then dem.room.retired[action.key] = true dem.room.items[action.key] = nil for i = #dem.room.order, 1, -1 do if dem.room.order[i] == action.key then table.remove(dem.room.order, i) end end -- Lifecycle messages belong to the immutable submitted action, never to a -- subsequently selected manual target. if dem.target == action.reference and selected and selected.key == action.key and selected.room == action.room then manualReference, selected = nil, nil dem.targeting.clear('hunt') end dem.room.notify() end end -- A preceding GMCP Remove may have retired this action before its kill text. reconcile(action) end
function hunt.onKill(name) local action = hunt.lastAction local normalized = type(name) == 'string' and dem.norm(name) or nil if action and normalized and action.names and action.names[normalized] then local provenance = submittedByName[normalized] if provenance and provenance.ambiguous and not action.retired then reconcile(action) else retire(action) end end end function hunt.onMissing() local action = hunt.lastAction if action and action.ambiguousMissing and not action.retired then reconcile(action) else retire(action) end end
function hunt.onRemoved(key) local action = hunt.lastAction if action and action.key == key and belongsToRoom(action) then action.retired = true reconcile(action) end if selected and selected.key == key and selected.room == dem.room.num then selected, manualReference = nil, nil dem.targeting.clear('hunt') elseif manualReference and dem.room.ready then -- An ID may disappear before the pending manual selection reaches step(). local item, foundKey = dem.room.resolve(manualReference) if item and foundKey == key then manualReference = nil end end schedule() end
local function validName(name) if type(name) ~= 'string' then return nil end name = dem.norm(name) if name == '' or name:find('[%c]') then return nil end return name end local function reject(reason) message(reason) return nil, reason end function hunt.add(name) local area = dem.room.area if not area then return reject('The current area is unknown.') end name = validName(name) if not name then return reject('Supply a denizen keyword or full name.') end dem.settings.areas[area] = dem.settings.areas[area] or {} dem.settings.areas[area][name] = true dem.saveSettings() message('Added ' .. name .. ' in ' .. area .. '.') if type(raiseEvent) == 'function' then raiseEvent('dem.huntListChanged') end schedule() return true end function hunt.remove(name) local area = dem.room.area if not area then return reject('The current area is unknown.') end name = validName(name) if not name then return reject('Supply a denizen keyword or full name.') end if dem.settings.areas[area] then dem.settings.areas[area][name] = nil end dem.saveSettings() message('Removed ' .. name .. ' in ' .. area .. '.') if type(raiseEvent) == 'function' then raiseEvent('dem.huntListChanged') end if selected and not selected.manual and not dem.room.matchesAllowlist(selected.item, areaList()) then selected = nil; clearOwned() end schedule() return true end function hunt.list() if not dem.room.area then message('The current area is unknown.'); return nil end local names = {} for name, allowed in pairs(areaList() or {}) do if allowed then names[#names + 1] = name end end table.sort(names) message(dem.room.area .. ': ' .. (#names > 0 and table.concat(names, ', ') or '(no allowed denizens)')) return names end function hunt.status(detailed) if detailed ~= true then message('Hunt mode ' .. (hunt.enabled and 'on' or 'off') .. '; target: ' .. (dem.target or 'none') .. '; ' .. hunt.reason) return hunt.enabled end local v, b = dem.vitals, dem.balances local function value(n) return n ~= nil and tostring(n) or 'unknown' end local refresh = dem.room.refresh local diagnostics = dem.room.diagnostics and dem.room.diagnostics() or {} local age = refresh and string.format('%.1fs', math.max(0, dem.now() - refresh.started)) or 'none' local count = 0 for key, item in pairs(dem.room.items) do if not dem.room.retired[key] and dem.room.living(item) then count = count + 1 end end message('Hunt mode ' .. (hunt.enabled and 'on' or 'off') .. '; area: ' .. (dem.room.area or 'unknown') .. '; target: ' .. (dem.target or 'none') .. '; limits: ' .. dem.settings.hpLimit .. '% health, ' .. dem.settings.manaLimit .. '% mana; HP: ' .. value(v.hp) .. '/' .. value(v.maxhp) .. '; MP: ' .. value(v.mp) .. '/' .. value(v.maxmp) .. '; balance: ' .. value(b.bal) .. '; equilibrium: ' .. value(b.eq) .. '; refresh: ' .. (dem.room.phase or 'unknown') .. '; request age: ' .. age .. '; retry: ' .. tostring(refresh and math.max(0, refresh.attempts - 1) or 0) .. '; ih: ' .. (refresh and refresh.ihSent and 'sent' or 'not sent') .. '; refresh reason: ' .. (refresh and refresh.reason or 'none') .. '; room: ' .. value(dem.room.num) .. '; context: ' .. value(diagnostics.contextId) .. '; roster: ' .. tostring(count) .. '; refresh mode: ' .. (refresh and (refresh.blocking and 'blocking' or 'background') or 'none') .. '; last GMCP room: ' .. value(diagnostics.lastReceivedRoom) .. '; refresh error: ' .. (diagnostics.refreshError or 'none') .. '; target type: ' .. (dem.targeting.kind or 'none') .. (hunt.enabled and '; state: ' or '; last stop: ') .. hunt.reason) return hunt.enabled end function hunt.setLimits(hp, mana) hp, mana = tonumber(hp), tonumber(mana) if not finite(hp) or not finite(mana) or hp < 0 or hp > 100 or mana < 0 or mana > 100 then return reject('Limits must be percentages between 0 and 100.') end dem.settings.hpLimit, dem.settings.manaLimit = hp, mana dem.saveSettings() schedule() return true end

Script.name: Room GUI
Script.script:
-- The GUI is a view of dem.room, never a second roster or attack controller. dem.ui = {panels = {}, initialized = false} local ui, owner, stopped, reported = dem.ui, dem, false, nil local kinds = {'denizens', 'items', 'players'} local titles = {denizens = 'Denizens', items = 'Items', players = 'Players'} local positions = {denizens = '0%', items = '33%', players = '66%'} ui.palette = { background = '#17151e', border = '#87394c', accent = '#b78aef', normal = {220, 216, 228}, allowed = {245, 199, 92}, selected = {196, 155, 255}, players = {103, 220, 235}, items = {132, 211, 156}, muted = {145, 139, 153} }
local function current() return not stopped and dem == owner end local function safe(fn, ...) local ok, result = pcall(fn, ...) if not ok then ui.lastError = tostring(result) if reported ~= ui.lastError then reported = ui.lastError pcall(owner.message, 'Room GUI: ' .. ui.lastError) end return false end return true, result end
local function literal(value) -- echo/echoPopup display literal text; discard terminal escapes/control bytes. return tostring(value or ''):gsub('\27%[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]', ''):gsub('[%c]', ' ') end
local function write(console, text, color, actions, hints) local rgb = ui.palette[color] or ui.palette.normal console:setFgColor(rgb[1], rgb[2], rgb[3]) if actions and #actions > 0 then console:echoPopup(literal(text), actions, hints, true) console:echo('\n') else console:echo(literal(text) .. '\n') end end
local function visible() for _, kind in ipairs(kinds) do local panel = ui.panels[kind] if panel and not panel.container.hidden then return true end end return false end
local function requestMissing() if not current() or not ui.initialized or not visible() or not owner.room.num or owner.room.ready then return end owner.room.subscribe() owner.room.request('Room GUI is waiting for room contents', false) end
local function callback(check, action) local context, num = owner.room.contextId, owner.room.num return function() if not current() or not ui.initialized or owner.room.contextId ~= context or owner.room.num ~= num then return end safe(function() if check() then action() end end) end end
local function itemNow(key) local item = owner.room.items[key] if not owner.room.ready or type(item) ~= 'table' or item.id ~= key then return nil end return item end
local function targetAction(key) return callback(function() return not owner.room.retired[key] and owner.room.eligible(itemNow(key)) end, function() owner.targeting.setDenizen(key) end) end
local function idLess(a, b) if #a ~= #b then return #a < #b end return a < b end
local function nameLess(a, b) local left, right = a.name:lower(), b.name:lower() if left == right then return a.name < b.name end return left < right end
local function selectedId() if owner.targeting.kind ~= 'denizen' or not owner.target then return nil end local action = owner.hunt.lastAction local preferred = action and action.reference == owner.target and action.key or nil local _, key = owner.room.identify(owner.target, preferred) return owner.room.items[key] and key or nil end
local function denizens(console) local byName, groups, count = {}, {}, 0 local selected = selectedId() local allowed = owner.settings.areas[owner.room.area] for _, key in ipairs(owner.room.order) do local item = owner.room.items[key] if owner.room.living(item) and not owner.room.retired[key] then local group = byName[item.name] if not group then group = {name = item.name, ids = {}, allowed = false, selected = false, protected = 0} byName[item.name] = group; groups[#groups + 1] = group end group.ids[#group.ids + 1] = key; count = count + 1 if key == selected then group.selected = true end if owner.room.eligible(item) then group.allowed = group.allowed or owner.room.matchesAllowlist(item, allowed) else group.protected = group.protected + 1 end end end table.sort(groups, nameLess) for _, group in ipairs(groups) do table.sort(group.ids, idLess) local actions, hints = {}, {} for _, key in ipairs(group.ids) do if owner.room.eligible(owner.room.items[key]) then actions[#actions + 1] = targetAction(key); hints[#hints + 1] = 'Target ID ' .. key end end local groupName, area = group.name, owner.room.area if area and group.protected < #group.ids then actions[#actions + 1] = callback(function() if owner.room.area ~= area or not owner.room.ready then return false end for _, item in pairs(owner.room.items) do if item.name == groupName and not owner.room.retired[item.id] and owner.room.eligible(item) then return true end end return false end, function() owner.hunt.add(groupName) end) hints[#hints + 1] = 'Add name to this area\'s hunt list' end local text = (group.selected and '[T] ' or '') .. group.name if #group.ids > 1 then text = text .. ' x' .. #group.ids end if group.protected > 0 then text = text .. (group.protected == #group.ids and ' [protected]' or ' [' .. group.protected .. ' protected]') end local color = group.protected == #group.ids and 'muted' or (group.selected and 'selected' or (group.allowed and 'allowed' or 'normal')) write(console, text, color, actions, hints) end return count end
local function items(console) local rows = {} for _, key in ipairs(owner.room.order) do local item = owner.room.items[key] if type(item) == 'table' and type(item.name) == 'string' and owner.trim(item.name) ~= '' and not owner.room.living(item) then rows[#rows + 1] = item end end table.sort(rows, function(a, b) if a.name == b.name then return idLess(a.id, b.id) end return nameLess(a, b) end) for _, item in ipairs(rows) do local key = item.id local function present() local live = itemNow(key); return live and not owner.room.living(live) end local actions = { callback(present, function() if type(send) == 'function' then send('get ' .. key) end end), callback(present, function() if type(send) == 'function' then send('probe ' .. key) end end) } local dead = type(item.attrib) == 'string' and item.attrib:lower():find('d', 1, true) write(console, item.name .. ' (' .. key .. ')', dead and 'muted' or 'items', actions, {'Get ID ' .. key, 'Probe ID ' .. key}) end return #rows end
local function selfName() local char = type(gmcp) == 'table' and gmcp.Char if type(char) ~= 'table' then return '' end local name = type(char.Name) == 'table' and char.Name.name or (type(char.Status) == 'table' and char.Status.name) return owner.norm(name) end
local function players(console) local rows, ownName = {}, selfName() for key, player in pairs(owner.room.players) do if key ~= ownName then rows[#rows + 1] = player end end table.sort(rows, nameLess) for _, player in ipairs(rows) do local name, key = player.name, player.name:lower() local action = callback(function() return owner.room.playersReady and owner.room.players[key] ~= nil and key ~= selfName() end, function() owner.targeting.setPlayer(name) end) local selected = owner.targeting.kind == 'player' and owner.norm(owner.target) == key write(console, (selected and '[T] ' or '') .. name, selected and 'selected' or 'players', {action}, {'Target ' .. name .. ': ' .. literal(player.fullname)}) end return #rows end
local renderers = {denizens = denizens, items = items, players = players} local function renderPanel(kind) local panel, room = ui.panels[kind], owner.room local console, count = panel.console, 0 console:clear() if kind == 'players' and room.num then write(console, room.name or 'Unknown room', 'normal') write(console, (room.area or 'Unknown area') .. ' (' .. room.num .. ')', 'muted') console:echo('\n') end if not room.num then write(console, room.disconnected and 'Disconnected' or 'Waiting for room information...', 'muted') elseif not (kind == 'players' and room.playersReady or kind ~= 'players' and room.ready) then write(console, kind == 'players' and 'Waiting for players...' or 'Waiting for room contents...', 'muted') else count = renderers[kind](console) if count == 0 then write(console, 'None', 'muted') end end panel.container:setTitle(titles[kind] .. ' (' .. count .. ')', ui.palette.accent) end
function ui.render() if not current() or not ui.initialized then return end for _, kind in ipairs(kinds) do safe(renderPanel, kind) end end
function ui.requestRender() if not current() or not ui.initialized or owner.runtime.timers['ui-render'] then return end owner.defer('ui-render', 0, ui.render) end
local function dispose(save) for _, kind in ipairs(kinds) do local panel = ui.panels[kind] if panel then local container = panel.container if save then safe(function() container:save() end) end safe(function() container:disableAutoSave() end) safe(function() if container.delete then container:delete() else container:hide() end end) ui.panels[kind] = nil end end ui.initialized = false end
function ui.init() if not current() then return false end if ui.initialized then return true end if not (Geyser and Geyser.Label and Geyser.MiniConsole and Adjustable and Adjustable.Container) then return false end local ok = safe(function() for _, kind in ipairs(kinds) do local name = 'Demonic.RoomUI.' .. titles[kind] local container = assert(Adjustable.Container:new({ name = name, x = 0, y = positions[kind], width = 300, height = '31%', titleText = titles[kind], titleTxtColor = ui.palette.accent, padding = 8, adjLabelstyle = 'background-color: ' .. ui.palette.background .. '; border: 2px solid ' .. ui.palette.border .. '; border-radius: 7px;', buttonstyle = 'QLabel { background-color: #462438; color: #ddc5eb; border-radius: 4px; }', autoSave = false, autoLoad = true }), 'Could not create the ' .. titles[kind] .. ' container.') ui.panels[kind] = {container = container} local back = assert(Geyser.Label:new({name = name .. '.Background', x = 0, y = 0, width = '100%', height = '100%'}, container), 'Could not create the ' .. titles[kind] .. ' background.') back:setStyleSheet('background-color: ' .. ui.palette.background .. ';') ui.panels[kind].console = assert(Geyser.MiniConsole:new({ name = name .. '.List', x = 5, y = 4, width = '-10px', height = '-8px', color = ui.palette.background, fontSize = 10, autoWrap = true, scrollBar = true }, back), 'Could not create the ' .. titles[kind] .. ' console.') end end) if not ok then dispose(false); return false end ui.initialized = true ui.render() safe(requestMissing) return true end
function ui.show() if not ui.init() then return false end for _, kind in ipairs(kinds) do safe(function() ui.panels[kind].container:show() end) end ui.render(); safe(requestMissing) return true end
function ui.hide() if not current() or not ui.initialized then return false end for _, kind in ipairs(kinds) do safe(function() ui.panels[kind].container:hide() end) end return true end
function ui.resetLayout() if not ui.init() then return false end for _, kind in ipairs(kinds) do safe(function() local container = ui.panels[kind].container container:disconnect(); container:detach(); container:unlockContainer(); container:restore() container:move(0, positions[kind]); container:resize(300, '31%'); container:show(); container:save() end) end ui.render(); safe(requestMissing) return true end
function ui.shutdown() if stopped then return end stopped = true; owner.cancel('ui-render'); dispose(true) end
owner.bind('dem.roomChanged', function(_, reason) if not current() or not ui.initialized then return end if reason == 'identity' or reason == 'reset' then owner.cancel('ui-render'); ui.render() if reason == 'identity' then safe(requestMissing) end else ui.requestRender() end end) owner.bind('dem.targetChanged', ui.requestRender) owner.bind('dem.huntListChanged', ui.requestRender)

Script.name: Ritualism Commands
Script.script:
dem.ritualism = {duality = true, costs = {fire = 9, ice = 9, inversion = 9, hammer = 9, vitality = 9}} local ritualism = dem.ritualism
local function validSymbols(symbols) if type(symbols) ~= 'table' or #symbols < 1 or #symbols > 2 then return nil, 'Trace requires one or two symbols.' end for i = 1, #symbols do if type(symbols[i]) ~= 'string' or not symbols[i]:match('^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_%-]*$') then return nil, 'Invalid ritualism symbol.' end end return true end
function ritualism.buildTrace(symbols, ref) local ok, err = validSymbols(symbols) if not ok then return nil, err end if #symbols == 2 and not ritualism.duality then return nil, 'Duality is not learned.' end local target, targetErr = dem.validReference(ref) if not target then return nil, targetErr end return 'trace ' .. table.concat(symbols, ' ') .. ' ' .. target end
function ritualism.manaCost(symbols) if not validSymbols(symbols) then return nil end local total = 0 for _, symbol in ipairs(symbols) do local cost = ritualism.costs[symbol] if type(cost) ~= 'number' then return nil end total = total + cost end return total end
function ritualism.buildDefence(name) if name == 'vitality' then return ritualism.buildTrace({'vitality'}, 'me') end end

Script.name: Malignosis Commands
Diabolist defences
Script.script:
-- Class registry and maintenance share the same action gate as Hunt. dem.diabolist = {defences = { {name = 'ouroboros', skill = 'malignosis', resource = 'prompt'}, {name = 'armor', skill = 'malignosis', resource = 'prompt'}, {name = 'regeneration', skill = 'malignosis', resource = 'prompt'}, {name = 'soulmask', skill = 'malignosis', resource = 'prompt'}, {name = 'syphon', skill = 'malignosis', resource = 'prompt'}, {name = 'vitality', skill = 'ritualism', resource = 'bal', mana = 9}, {name = 'nightfall', skill = 'nightfall', resource = 'eq', mana = 27} }} dem.defences = {enabled = false, active = {}, reason = 'Disabled.'} local defences = dem.defences
function defences.stop(reason) local wasEnabled = defences.enabled defences.enabled = false defences.reason = reason or 'Disabled by user.' -- A pending command still owns its confirmation and recovery after toggling off. if wasEnabled then dem.message('Defence maintenance off: ' .. defences.reason) end end
function defences.reset(reason) defences.stop(reason) defences.active = {} dem.cancel('defence-watchdog') end
function defences.toggle() if defences.enabled then defences.stop(); return false end if dem.balances.dead then dem.message('Defence maintenance remains off while you are dead.'); return false end defences.enabled = true defences.reason = 'Waiting for character readiness.' dem.message('Defence maintenance on.') dem.schedule() return true end
function defences.setActive(name, active) local known = false for _, entry in ipairs(dem.diabolist.defences) do if entry.name == name then known = true; break end end if not known or type(active) ~= 'boolean' then return false end defences.active[name] = active if name == 'ouroboros' and not active then for _, dependent in ipairs({'armor', 'regeneration', 'soulmask', 'syphon'}) do defences.active[dependent] = false end end local action = dem.balances.action if active and action and action.kind == 'defence' and action.defence == name then dem.balances.confirmDefence(action) end dem.schedule() return true end
local function finite(n) return type(n) == 'number' and n == n and n ~= math.huge and n ~= -math.huge end
function defences.step() if not defences.enabled then return end local b, v = dem.balances, dem.vitals if b.dead then defences.stop('You are dead.'); return end if dem.hunt.enabled then defences.reason = 'Paused while Hunt is on.'; return end if b.action then defences.reason = 'Waiting for the current command confirmation and recovery.'; return end if not finite(v.hp) or v.hp <= 0 or not finite(v.mp) or v.mp < 0 or not finite(v.maxmp) or v.maxmp <= 0 or v.prone == nil or v.stunned == nil then defences.reason = 'Waiting for character data.'; return end if v.mp / v.maxmp * 100 <= dem.settings.manaLimit then defences.stop('Mana reached the configured limit.'); return end if not b.bal or not b.eq or v.prone or v.stunned then defences.reason = 'Waiting for balance, equilibrium, standing and unstunned status.'; return end for _, entry in ipairs(dem.diabolist.defences) do if not defences.active[entry.name] then if entry.mana and v.mp < entry.mana then defences.reason = 'Waiting for enough mana for ' .. entry.name .. '.'; return end local skill = dem[entry.skill] local command = skill.buildDefence(entry.name) if not command then defences.stop('Cannot build ' .. entry.name .. '.'); return end local action = {kind = 'defence', defence = entry.name, resource = entry.resource, started = dem.now()} if not b.beginAction(action) then return end defences.reason = 'Waiting for ' .. entry.name .. ' confirmation and recovery.' dem.defer('defence-watchdog', 10, function() if b.action ~= action then return end defences.stop('No confirmed completion for ' .. entry.name .. '; check the game response before retrying.') if dem.hunt.enabled then dem.hunt.stop('The pending defence has not completed.') end end) send(command) return end end defences.reason = 'All listed defences are confirmed active.' end

Script.name: Nightfall Commands
Initialize Demonic
Script.script:
-- Register only after every System and profession module has been loaded. function dem.onPrompt(text) dem.cancel('hunt-step') dem.runtime.promptSerial = (dem.runtime.promptSerial or 0) + 1 if text then dem.balances.parsePrompt(text) end dem.balances.onPrompt() dem.step() dem.balances.endPrompt() end
function dem.resetConnection(event) dem.defences.reset('Connection changed; type ddef to enable again.') dem.hunt.stop('Connection changed; type hunt to enable again.') dem.hunt.lastAction = nil dem.hunt.resetTerminalHistory() dem.targeting.clear('system') dem.balances.reset() dem.room.reset(event == 'sysDisconnectionEvent') end
function dem.onDeath() dem.defences.reset('You are dead.') dem.hunt.stop('You are dead.') dem.hunt.lastAction = nil dem.hunt.resetTerminalHistory() dem.targeting.clear('system') dem.balances.clearForDeath() dem.room.reset() end
function dem.onBalanceUnavailable(kind) return dem.balances.taken(kind) end
local function gmcpHandler(event, fn) dem.bind('gmcp.' .. event, function() local value = gmcp for field in event:gmatch('[^.]+') do value = type(value) == 'table' and value[field] or nil end if value ~= nil then fn(value) end end) end
gmcpHandler('Char.Vitals', dem.balances.onVitals) gmcpHandler('Room.Info', dem.room.onInfo) gmcpHandler('Room.Players', dem.room.onPlayers) gmcpHandler('Room.AddPlayer', dem.room.onAddPlayer) gmcpHandler('Room.RemovePlayer', dem.room.onRemovePlayer) gmcpHandler('Char.Name', function() dem.room.notify('players') end) gmcpHandler('Char.Status', function() dem.room.notify('players') end) gmcpHandler('Char.Items.List', dem.room.onList) gmcpHandler('Char.Items.Add', dem.room.onAdd) gmcpHandler('Char.Items.Remove', dem.room.onRemove) gmcpHandler('Char.Items.Update', dem.room.onUpdate) dem.bind('sysDisconnectionEvent', dem.resetConnection) dem.bind('sysConnectionEvent', dem.resetConnection) dem.bind('sysProtocolEnabled', function(_, protocol) if protocol == 'GMCP' then dem.room.subscribe() end end) dem.bind('sysLoadEvent', function() dem.ui.init() end) dem.bind('sysExitEvent', function() dem.saveSettings(); dem.shutdown() end) dem.bind('sysUninstall', function(_, package) if package == 'Demonic' then dem.saveSettings(); dem.shutdown() end end)
dem.ui.init()
-- Installation into an already-connected profile may precede the next packet. -- Hydrate vitals and room identity, but never trust a cached room item list. if type(gmcp) == 'table' then if gmcp.Char or gmcp.Room then dem.room.subscribe() end if gmcp.Char and type(gmcp.Char.Vitals) == 'table' then dem.balances.onVitals(gmcp.Char.Vitals) end if gmcp.Room and type(gmcp.Room.Info) == 'table' then dem.room.onInfo(gmcp.Room.Info) -- The identity is cached; its item list must be requested afresh. dem.room.request('Installation into a connected profile') end end
